1532968.steps: Build a VPN tunnel between DUT and Fw2. Test traffic with all IPsec encryption and authentication algorithms. Ping small packet (length < 1500) from PC2 to PC1. Ping with payload > 2000 from PC2 to PC1. Adjust ping payload length, so that the ESP packet length is in the range 1984 ~ 2016. Ping from PC2 to PC1. Adjust ping payload length in range 1984 ~ 2016. Ping from PC2 to PC1. GEN7-38149 Another test method is testing with strongswan, ping from strongswan's network with payload over 2000 bytes.
1532968.title: GEN7-38149: Under default algorithm like AESGCM, when there is a fragmented large ESP packet (length > 2000) comes to firewall, firewall will reassemble the packet and decrypt it.
1532968.description:

On Fw2, enable "Fragment VPN packets after applying ESP" on diag page.
